title: Topic 11 · 意识的神经关联 NCC — 神经科学
title_en: Topic 11 · Neural Correlates of Consciousness (NCC) — Neuroscience

questions.question: 双眼竞争为什么是寻找意识的神经关联（NCC）的理想范式？
options: 它能让两张图同时进入意识，便于比较两份体验各自对应的那组神经活动
两眼收到的输入不变，觉察却在两张图之间翻转，能把意识和刺激分开
它让刺激快速变化，能测出意识跟上刺激变化所需要的时间
它只刺激一只眼睛，另一侧视觉皮层的活动正好可作对照组
questions.explanation: 找 NCC 要做减法：刺激不变，只让意识变。双眼竞争中两眼输入一秒不变，大脑却一次只让你意识到一张图、来回翻转，于是跟着觉察翻转的活动就和稳定的刺激干净地分开了。两张图并不会同时进入意识。
questions.question_en: Why is binocular rivalry an ideal paradigm for finding the neural correlates of consciousness (NCC)?
options_en: Both images enter awareness at once, making it easy to compare the neural activity of each
Input to the eyes stays fixed while awareness flips between the images, separating consciousness from stimulus
The stimulus changes rapidly, revealing how long awareness takes to catch up
Only one eye is stimulated, so the other side's visual cortex serves as a control
questions.explanation_en: Finding the NCC is subtraction: hold the stimulus fixed and let only awareness change. In rivalry the input never changes, yet you're aware of only one image at a time and it flips, so activity that tracks the flip separates cleanly from the steady stimulus. The two images never enter awareness together.

questions.question: 早年实验常发现「有意识时前额叶亮起」，并据此认为前额叶是意识的关键。无报告范式对此提出了什么质疑？
options: 前额叶确是意识所在，但按键报告这个动作会抑制它，导致信号被低估
那片活动在不同被试之间差异太大，结果根本无法被重复
那片活动可能是刺激太强造成的，与被试有没有觉察并无关系
那片活动可能来自按键报告所需的记忆、决策和运动，而不是体验本身
questions.explanation: 从「看见」到「按键」要经过工作记忆、决策和运动指令，这些都由前额叶挑大梁。无报告范式改用眼震、瞳孔偷读被试所见，撤掉报告后前额叶的「意识信号」大幅缩水，说明其中不少是报告的账。
questions.question_en: Early experiments often found the prefrontal cortex lighting up with conscious perception and concluded it was key to consciousness. What doubt did no-report paradigms raise?
options_en: The prefrontal cortex is the seat of consciousness, but reporting suppresses it, so the signal is underestimated
That activity varies too much between subjects to be replicated at all
That activity may come from overly strong stimuli, unrelated to whether subjects were aware
That activity may reflect the memory, decision and motor work of reporting, not the experience itself
questions.explanation_en: Getting from 'seeing' to 'pressing a button' involves working memory, a decision and a motor command, all heavily prefrontal. No-report paradigms read the percept from eye movements or pupil size instead, and the prefrontal 'consciousness signal' shrinks a lot, suggesting much of it belonged to reporting.

questions.question: Cogitate 对抗性协作中，全局工作空间理论和整合信息论的招牌预言都没被证实。为什么说这并非白忙一场？
options: 两派事先写死预言、约定输赢，意识理论第一次真的可能被证伪
结果表明两种理论其实是同一个理论的两种表述，可以合并成一个
结果表明意识无法用神经活动来研究，今后可以省下相关投入
中立实验室最终裁定后部热区一方胜出，这场争论就此结束
questions.explanation: 意识理论的老毛病是解释都在事后补，怎么都能自圆其说。Cogitate 让两派预注册预言、约定哪种结果算输，交给中立实验室；两家都被自己签字画押的预言证伪了一部分，这正是把意识拉进科学的样子。结果是平局，并没有分出胜负。
questions.question_en: In the Cogitate adversarial collaboration, the signature predictions of both Global Neuronal Workspace and Integrated Information Theory failed. Why was it not a wasted effort?
options_en: Both sides pre-registered predictions and agreed what counted as losing, so a consciousness theory could truly fail for once
It showed the two theories are really one theory stated two ways, so they can be merged
It showed consciousness can't be studied through neural activity, saving future investment
The neutral labs ruled that the posterior hot zone camp won, ending the debate
questions.explanation_en: Consciousness theories long explained data after the fact and could fit anything. Cogitate had both camps pre-register predictions and losing conditions for neutral labs to test; each was partly falsified by its own signed predictions, which is what bringing consciousness into science looks like. The result was a draw, not a win.
